overview_description.description:
Lark is a developer of chronic disease prevention and management platform used to prevent chronic conditions. The company uses cutting-edge AI combined with human coaches and connected devices to provide real-time, personalized, 24/7 support, and counseling to help users make healthier choices and manage their conditions. Its CDC-recognized Diabetes Prevention Program, Wellness Program, Diabetes Care Program, and Hypertension Program have 1.5 million users and have demonstrated clinically validated improved health outcomes published in 11 peer-reviewed journals and analyst reports.

Lark was founded by Julia Hu and Jeff Zira in 2011 and is headquartered in 	Mountain View, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Lark is a digital health startup that provides virtual care through AI coaching, smart devices, and tele-monitoring.

product.name: Lark Digital Health Platform
product.description: A mobile and cloud-based platform that combines AI coaching, health education, goal setting, progress tracking, and connected-device data for chronic-condition prevention and management.

product.name: Lark Weight Management Program
product.description: A digital weight-management program providing nutrition, exercise, behavior-change, and lifestyle coaching, with support for members using physician-prescribed GLP-1 or other weight-loss medications.

product.name: Lark Diabetes Care
product.description: A digital diabetes-management service that combines connected glucose monitoring, personalized coaching, medication and lifestyle support, care-gap tracking, and escalation to clinical or telephonic resources.

product.name: Lark Diabetes Prevention Program
product.description: A yearlong, CDC-recognized digital program for people with prediabetes that uses structured lessons, coaching, lifestyle tracking, and connected devices to help prevent or delay type 2 diabetes.

product.name: Lark Hypertension Program
product.description: A digital hypertension-support program that combines connected blood-pressure monitoring with personalized coaching on diet, activity, weight, and lifestyle management.

product.name: Lark Well-being Coach
product.description: A general wellness coaching service that provides digital lessons, personalized goals, habit tracking, and support for sleep, stress, physical activity, nutrition, weight, and tobacco cessation.
